content:
Today Apple released iOS 27 beta 5 and related updates, but also simultaneously launched a surprising "second wave" of beta versions, covering systems such as iOS 26.6.1 and macOS 26.6.2.

iOS 26.6.1, iPadOS 26.6.1, and macOS 26.6.2 beta versions officially released

If you have been installing Apple's beta software, you have two choices today.

iOS 27 beta 5 finally arrived three weeks later, with Apple continuing to push forward its preparations for the next major system version throughout the entire summer.

However, Apple has also just released a new round of beta versions for iOS 26 and its related updates.

iOS 26.6.1, iPadOS 26.6.1, and macOS 26.6.2 beta 1 are now available.

It is uncommon for Apple to release beta versions for such minor updates. Generally speaking, the company will only push small fix versions directly without prior notice.

These versions may replace larger updates such as iOS 26.7. But regardless of the reason, Apple clearly sees a reason to release these new iOS 26 updates in beta form before their official launch.

iOS 26.6.1 and similar versions are expected to only contain security updates and bug fixes. If we discover any specific changes, we will let everyone know.

Note: If you have already upgraded your iPhone to the iOS 27 beta, you will not see the option to install iOS 26.6.1. That version is only available for devices still running iOS 26.

Are you still using iOS 26? Have you found anything different in the iOS 26.6.1 beta? Feel free to let us know in the comments section.
